relations.product: capital and business alliance for resource circulation: Renet collects and dismantles end-of-life small electronics; JX Advanced Metals Group recovers metals by smelting and recycling
relations.quote: Through this alliance, Renet Japan will leverage its collection networks and expertise at the "front-end" of resource circulation, while the JX Advanced Metals Group will contribute its smelting and recycling technologies and expertise in resource recovery.
relations.label: JX Advanced Metals press release: Announcement of Capital and Business Alliance with Renet (10-19-2026)
